info.title: Duma CRM API
info.description:
## Welcome to the Duma CRM API

The Duma CRM API powers the backend for a multi-tenant café franchise platform — handling order management, real-time stock tracking, customer loyalty, staff shifts, and analytics across multiple brands and locations.

---

## Authentication

All endpoints except `/health` and `/auth/*` require a **bearer token**. Sign in at `POST /auth/sign-in/email`; the response returns your token in the `set-auth-token` header. Store it (e.g. `localStorage`) and send it on every request as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

In these docs, click **Authorize** and paste your token to try authenticated endpoints.

---

## Capability & Scope Model

Access is controlled by **capabilities** granted to a role, plus the **scope** on
each staff profile. Roles no longer carry a rank: authority is not a single axis,
so a rank could not express "sees everything, changes nothing" (`auditor`) and
wrongly placed `marketing_manager` below `store_manager` for customer data.

| Role | Holds |
|---|---|
| `super_admin` | Every capability, across all tenants |
| `franchise_owner` | Everything within their tenant, including pay, access control and erasure |
| `store_manager` | Their site: orders, refunds, stock, rota, customers — but not pay, bank details or role changes |
| `marketing_manager` | The customer relationship: base, consent, segments, campaigns |
| `hr_manager` | People, pay and documents across the estate — no till, stock or menu |
| `barista` | The counter: orders, payments, order status, guest lookup and enrolment, waste, own shift |
| `auditor` | The read half of every domain, and nothing else |

| Scope | Description |
|---|---|
| `global` | All locations within the tenant |
| `franchise` | Full franchise-wide access |
| `location` | Only explicitly assigned location IDs |

Each endpoint requires a named capability such as `customers:read` or
`orders:refund`. A 403 names the missing capability in its body, so a client can
report what the user lacks rather than inferring it from a rank. The grants live
in `src/lib/capabilities.ts`.

---

## Key Concepts

- **Tenants** — Franchise brands. Each tenant owns locations, menu items, modifiers, and stock items.
- **Locations** — Physical outlets. Orders are placed and stock is tracked per-location; the menu itself is brand-wide.
- **Menu & modifiers** — A menu item has one brand-wide `price`. Modifiers are reusable add-ons (name + `price_adjust`) attached to items via `menu_item_modifiers`. Order prices are computed server-side from these records.
- **Orders** — Created from POS (`pos`) or mobile (`mobile`). Item names and prices are computed server-side; completing an order consumes its recipe from physical stock units. Supports pagination, bulk status updates (`PATCH /orders/bulk-status`), soft delete (`DELETE /orders/:id`), and CSV/JSON export (`GET /orders/export`). Customers can view their own orders at `GET /orders/my`.
- **Stock** — Tracked per-location. Low-stock alerts are returned alongside each order response. Bulk-update up to 50 location stock quantities in one request via `PATCH /location-stock/bulk`. Query all rows below threshold via `GET /location-stock/alerts`. View paginated movement history per item at `GET /stock-items/:id/movements`.
- **Customers** — End consumers who can self-register via `POST /customers/me`, which links their account to an existing POS record matched by phone number.
- **Shifts** — Staff clock in/out per location. Active shifts are queryable in real time. Store managers and above can list all shifts with an optional `?locationId` filter.
- **Analytics** — All analytics endpoints require `store_manager+` and accept `from`, `to` (ISO 8601), and `locationId` query parameters. Date range defaults to the last 30 days. Responses include `Cache-Control` headers (60–300 s).
- **Audit Logs** — The following actions write an immutable audit row: order create/cancel/status change, bulk status update, staff creation, stock adjust/transfer/bulk update, data export, tenant delete, location delete. Query via `GET /audit-logs` (`franchise_owner+`, paginated).
- **Pagination** — `GET /orders` and `GET /audit-logs` support `?page` and `?limit` and return `{ data, total, page, limit, pages }`.

delete.description: Fulfils a GDPR erasure request. The row is kept but every piece of personal data on it is overwritten — name, phone, email, date of birth, notes, allergies, dietary needs and alerts — and `anonymisedAt` is stamped. The row survives so that order and payment history stays intact for financial reporting, which there is a separate legal basis to retain; what is removed is the ability to tie it to a person. Marketing suppression is kept, hashed, so the address cannot be re-enrolled. This cannot be undone.

post.summary: Merge one customer record into another
post.description: Soft merge. The losing record is kept and pointed at the survivor, never deleted, so the merge can be undone with POST /customers/:id/unmerge. History is not moved: reads resolve the survivor plus everything merged into it. Allergies, dietary needs and alerts are unioned; contact gaps on the survivor are filled from the loser but existing values are never overwritten. Points move across as explained ledger entries.
